surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
SOURCE: The caller-supplied url and the transport and resolve_host dependencies.
TRUST: Transport surfaces raw HTTP status codes and does not silently follow redirects.
SINK: The url submitted to transport and the resulting str body returned to the caller.
GUARD: Validate url scheme is http or https and port is the default; otherwise raise ValueError. After invoking transport, enforce clause 5 exactly: reject every redirect response without following its Location value, regardless of whether that new destination also appears to be public, by raising ValueError for any 3xx status; return body only when status is exactly 200, else raise ValueError.
ORDER: Validate url scheme and default port. Call transport(url). Reject any 3xx status per clause 5 with ValueError. Return body if status is 200; raise ValueError for all other statuses.
EFFECT: Returns the fetched text for allowed default-port HTTP(S) destinations on status 200, and raises ValueError for disallowed URLs and every non-200 response including all redirects.
END_PLAN
